VIVHITE_CHARACTER_VIVHITE_CHARACTER.desc:
A silver-haired magical girl and master of mathematical magic, equally fluent in mathematics, computation, and art.
She pays life to cast formulae, conserves the cost with [gold]Margin[/gold], expands life through [gold]Dimension Up[/gold], and closes crimson proofs with uncapped [gold]Drain[/gold].
VIVHITE_CHARACTER_VIVHITE_CHARACTER.flav: Behind golden glasses, violet eyes turn geometry, algorithms, and color into serene, weaponless magic.
VIVHITE_CHARACTER_VIVHITE_CHARACTER.gold: A finite sum. Spend it where the proof needs it.
VIVHITE_CHARACTER_VIVHITE_CHARACTER.sele: Vivhite dons the Solitary Crown; mathematical starlight follows.
VIVHITE_CHARACTER_VIVHITE_CHARACTER.unlo: Complete a run as [pink]{Prerequisite}[/pink] to unlock this character.
VIVHITE_CHARACTER_VIVHITE_CHARACTER.vict: Every dimension converges. Vivhite writes the final proof in light.
